ns2:course.label: Electric Viola
ns2:course.description: Instruction in electric viola at the undergraduate level. Music majors must register concurrently in an approved ensemble. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course.
